name: Making distributed learning faster and fairer
gist: When machine learning training spreads across many computers with different data, how do you keep progress fast and balanced? Papers tackle communication costs, unequal data distribution, and coordination.
explain: When a company trains a model, it often spreads the work across many computers because no single machine is fast enough. Each computer has some of the training data, and they need to coordinate: compare their progress, share what they learned, and decide how to update the shared model. But sending information between computers is slow—sometimes slower than the actual computation—which means training gets bottlenecked by network traffic instead of computing. So the first problem is communication cost: how do you train 100 times faster while sending 1/100th the data, because the original way sends the same amount but takes 100 times longer?

The second problem is fairness. Not all computers have the same data—one might have data from New York, another from rural areas. If you average their updates equally, the model may work well in cities but fail in small towns. Or one computer has 10 times more data than another; should it have 10 times more influence? Real systems also have stragglers (slow computers that hold up the whole group) and privacy constraints (a hospital's data must never leave their server). These create tension: speed pulls you toward sending less and averaging more, but fairness and privacy pull you toward keeping data local and giving everyone a voice.

Papers in this area use several strategies. Some compress the messages between computers so fewer bits travel the network but the model still learns, which speeds up training because there is less data to send. Others use clever averaging where each computer's update gets weighted by how many examples it trained on, so larger datasets influence the final answer more fairly. Some designs let computers work asynchronously—they do not wait for slow peers—but adjust how much each update counts based on how stale its information is, so fast computers do not run ahead of slow ones. A few papers attack the stragglers directly, using faster hardware or splitting work unequally so the slow computer has less to do and can keep up with the group, which means no computer has to wait for a bottleneck. The realization is that speed and fairness are not opposites if you design the coordination carefully.

papers.title: Beyond Short Steps in Frank-Wolfe Algorithms
papers.contribution: Presents primal-dual convergence proof; empirical results demonstrate optimistic algorithm outperforms existing methods with practical stopping criteria.

papers.title: Beyond Softmax and Entropy: Convergence Rates of Policy Gradients with $\boldsymbol{f}$-SoftArgmax Parameterization $\&$ Coupled Regularizat
papers.contribution: f-PG establishes the first explicit non-asymptotic last-iterate convergence guarantees for finite MDPs without preconditioning and achieves polynomial sample complexity, contrasting with exponential complexity of softmax parameterization.

papers.title: Composite Optimization with Error Feedback: the Dual Averaging Approach
papers.contribution: First strong convergence analysis for composite optimization with error feedback, enabling communication-efficient distributed machine learning with theoretical guarantees.

papers.title: Convergence Dynamics of Over-Parameterized Score Matching for a Single Gaussian
papers.contribution: Proves global convergence at sufficient noise scale resembling gradient EM behavior; identifies convergence under exponentially small initialization in low-noise regime and demonstrates failure cases without proper initialization.

papers.title: DeMo: Decoupled Momentum Optimization
papers.contribution: Reduces per-step communication by up to 100x with minimal computational overhead; 300M- and 1B-parameter models transmit 85x less data than AdamW-DDP while maintaining comparable loss and accuracy.

papers.title: FZOO: Fast Zeroth-Order Optimizer for Fine‑Tuning Large Language Models towards Adam‑Scale Speed
papers.contribution: On average outperforms MeZO by +3% accuracy while requiring 3x fewer forward passes; for RoBERTa-large achieves +5.6% improvement and 18x reduction in forward passes, reaching Adam-scale convergence speed.

papers.title: Gradient-Normalized Smoothness for Optimization with Approximate Hessians
papers.contribution: Establishes universal global convergence rates for convex and non-convex objectives with Hölder-continuous Hessians, quasi-self-concordant functions, and broader classes; applies to logistic regression, softmax, and Fisher/Gauss-Newton approximations.

papers.title: Implicit Bias and Loss of Plasticity in Matrix Completion: Depth Promotes Low-Rankness
papers.contribution: Explains loss of plasticity phenomenon in matrix completion, showing deep models avoid plasticity loss through low-rank bias while depth-2 networks fail, providing mechanistic insight into depth effects.

papers.title: Layerwise Federated Learning for Heterogeneous Quantum Clients using Quorus
papers.contribution: Quorus improves testing accuracy by 12.4% on average over state-of-the-art methods on both simulated and real quantum hardware.

papers.title: Mitigating Non-IID Drift in Zeroth-Order Federated LLM Fine-Tuning with Transferable Sparsity
papers.contribution: Enables cost-effective federated LLM fine-tuning with superior performance compared to full-parameter zeroth-order baselines and improved handling of data heterogeneity.

papers.title: Newton Method Revisited: Global Convergence Rates up to $O(1/k^3)$ for Stepsize Schedules and Linesearch Procedures
papers.contribution: We provide strong convergence guarantees for Newton method with exact linesearch, covering cases with multiple smoothness parameterizations or unknown smoothness constants.

papers.title: Non-Convex Federated Optimization under Cost-Aware Client Selection
papers.contribution: The proposed algorithm achieves the best-known communication and local complexities among existing federated optimization methods for non-convex optimization.

papers.title: Proving the Limited Scalability of Centralized Distributed Optimization via a New Lower Bound Construction
papers.contribution: Demonstrates fundamental limitations in centralized distributed optimization, showing that unbiased random sparsification alone cannot overcome server communication bottlenecks.

papers.title: Tighter Performance Theory of FedExProx
papers.contribution: Demonstrates FedExProx can provably outperform GD and extends to Polyak-Łojasiewicz conditions, outperforming previous strongly convex analysis.

papers.title: A Convergence Analysis of Adaptive Optimizers under Floating-point Quantization
papers.contribution: Both algorithms retain rates close to full-precision provided mantissa length scales logarithmically with iterations, with Muon more robust than Adam.

papers.title: A Direct Second-Order Method for Solving Two-Player Zero-Sum Games
papers.contribution: The hybrid algorithm achieves order-of-magnitude speedups over existing first-order methods for high-precision Nash equilibrium solutions.

papers.title: A New Initialization to Control Gradients in Sinusoidal Neural Networks
papers.contribution: The new initialization consistently outperforms standard schemes on function fitting and image reconstruction tasks, including physics-informed neural networks.

papers.title: A Short and Unified Convergence Analysis of the SAG, SAGA, and IAG Algorithms
papers.contribution: Provides short and modular proofs with high-probability bounds for SAG and SAGA extendable to non-convex objectives and Markovian sampling, obtaining best known rates for IAG significantly improving prior bounds.

papers.title: A Sketch-and-Project Analysis of Subsampled Natural Gradient Algorithms
papers.contribution: Provides global convergence guarantees for any mini-batch size and reveals how SNG exploits spectral decay in model Jacobian better than SGD.

papers.title: A Tight Theory of Error Feedback Algorithms in Distributed Optimization
papers.contribution: Recovers known best guarantees possible in single-agent regime with convergence analysis independent of the number of agents.

papers.title: A proximal ADMM for multiblock problems with block anti-upper triangular constraints
papers.contribution: Extends theoretical understanding of multi-block ADMM and proves linear convergence under four different scenarios in the strongly convex setting.

papers.title: Accelerated Dual Method for Distributed Optimization: An Inexact-Gradient View of Local Updates
papers.contribution: Converges for any number of local updates, attaining optimal communication complexity; proves convergence under inexact accelerated gradient framework with optimal reproducibility under biased gradients.

papers.title: Accelerated Multiple Wasserstein Gradient Flows for Multi-objective Distributional Optimization
papers.contribution: A-MWGraD achieves a convergence rate of O(1/t^2) for geodesically convex objectives and O(e^{-sqrt(beta)t}) for strongly geodesically convex objectives, improving upon MWGraD's O(1/t) rate.

papers.title: Asymmetric Perturbation in Solving Bilinear Saddle-Point Optimization
papers.contribution: Achieves linear last-iterate convergence with a parameter-free variant that retains the linear rate in both normal-form and extensive-form games.

papers.title: Asynchronous Matching with Dynamic Sampling for Multimodal Dataset Distillation
papers.contribution: Achieves gains of 4.5% IR@1, 9.6% IR@5, and 10.9% IR@10 on Flickr30k 200 pairs with negligible computational overhead.

papers.title: BESplit: Bias-Compensated Split Federated Learning with Evidential Aggregation
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods in accuracy, convergence stability, and computational efficiency under diverse non-IID settings.

papers.title: Balanced LoRA: Removing Parameter Invariance to Accelerate Convergence
papers.contribution: BaLoRA converges faster than standard LoRA and achieves superior performance across fine-tuning tasks.

papers.title: Beyond Binary: Continuous State Optimization with Graph-Structured Objectives
papers.contribution: Reduces movement costs by over a factor of three in heterogeneous systems while maintaining similar cumulative losses, enabling efficient multi-objective optimization with system stability.

papers.title: Birch SGD: A Tree Graph Framework for Local and Asynchronous SGD Methods
papers.contribution: Provides unified graph-based interpretation of optimization dynamics with O((R+1)L∆/ε + σ²L∆/ε²) iteration rate showing trade-offs across methods.

papers.title: Byzantine-Robust Federated Learning with Learnable Aggregation Weights
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms existing Byzantine-robust FL methods, particularly with highly heterogeneous data and large proportions of malicious clients.

papers.title: Cautious Optimizers: Improving Training with One Line of Code
papers.contribution: Consistent speed-up on LLM pretraining and post-training with better results on MAE pretraining and minimal hyperparameter tuning required.

papers.title: Certificate-Guided Pruning for Stochastic Lipschitz Optimization
papers.contribution: CGP achieves sample complexity Õ(ε^-(2+α)) and demonstrates strong empirical performance across 12 benchmarks with principled stopping criteria.

papers.title: Class-Grouped Normalized Momentum and Faster Hyperparameter Exploration to Tackle Class Imbalance in Federated Learning
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms baselines on four long-tailed benchmarks and proprietary chip-defect dataset, with FedHOO providing further gains in small-scale federations.

papers.title: Clipped Gradient Methods for Nonsmooth Convex Optimization under Heavy-Tailed Noise: A Refined Analysis
papers.contribution: Offers faster convergence rates: O(σₗdₑff^(-1/2p)ln^(1-1/p)(1/δ)T^(1/p-1)) for nonsmooth convex and O(σₗ²dₑff^(-1/p)ln^(2-2/p)(1/δ)T^(2/p-2)) for strongly convex problems.

papers.title: Clipping Makes Distributed and Federated Asynchronous SGD Robust to Stragglers
papers.contribution: Shows clipping removes dependence on maximum delay in oracle complexity, with convergence in expectation and high-probability convergence guarantees in asynchronous optimization.

papers.title: Converge Faster, Talk Less: Hessian-Informed Federated Zeroth-Order Optimization
papers.contribution: HiSo achieves accelerated convergence independent of Lipschitz constant L and dimension d, delivering 1-5x speedup in communication rounds over ZO-FL baselines.

papers.title: Convergence Analysis of Decentralized Hessian-/Jacobian-Free Algorithm for Nonconvex Stochastic Bilevel Optimization
papers.contribution: First algorithm for nonconvex decentralized bi-level optimization with convergence guarantees under mild conditions; validated on hyperparameter optimization and model pruning.

papers.title: Convergence Analysis of the Lion Optimizer in Centralized and Distributed Settings
papers.contribution: Establishes linear speedup with respect to number of nodes and introduces communication-efficient variants with convergence guarantees.

papers.title: Convergence Rate Analysis of the AdamW-Style Shampoo: Unifying One-Sided and Two-Sided Preconditioning
papers.contribution: Proves convergence rate analogous to optimal SGD under ideal spectral conditions with balanced dimensions.

papers.title: Convergence Rate of the Last Iterate of Stochastic Proximal Algorithms
papers.contribution: Proves Õ(1/√T) convergence rate for last iterate under relaxed bounded variance assumptions; applies to graph-guided regularizers in federated learning.

papers.title: Convergence of Muon with Newton-Schulz
papers.contribution: Theory justifies practical Newton-Schulz design of Muon and explains how it matches exact-polar behavior at faster wall-clock time.

papers.title: Convergence of Regret Matching in Potential Games and Constrained Optimization
papers.contribution: First proof that RM+ is a sound first-order optimizer with O_epsilon(1/epsilon^2) convergence when regrets are bounded, and a matching lower bound for RM.

papers.title: Convergence of Steepest Descent and Adam under Non-Uniform Smoothness
papers.contribution: Results show sign GD converges linearly and faster than GD for logistic regression on separable data, and Adam/RMSProp achieve linear convergence with constant step-size on certain neural networks.

papers.title: Corner Gradient Descent
papers.contribution: Achieves optimal rates up to O(t^-2-zeta) through contour-based optimization while accounting for spectral and noise conditions.

papers.title: DecFus: Decentralized Layer-wise Fusion with Dynamic Exploration and Exploitation
papers.contribution: Proves convergence without assuming doubly stochastic aggregation matrices and demonstrates superior performance over CFL/DFL methods across IID and non-IID scenarios.

papers.title: Decentralized Bandits without Global Clock for Dynamic Matching Market
papers.contribution: Way-SE achieves O(K² log T / Δmin²) regret and Way-SE-2S achieves sublinear regret without global signals or restrictive preference structures.

papers.title: Decentralized Nonconvex Optimization under Heavy-Tailed Noise: Normalization and Optimal Convergence
papers.contribution: Achieves first optimal non-asymptotic rate O(1/T^{(p-1)/(3p-2)}) matching centralized lower bound; demonstrates topology-independent speedup.

papers.title: DeepAFL: Deep Analytic Federated Learning
papers.contribution: DeepAFL outperforms state-of-the-art baselines by up to 8.42% across three benchmark datasets while maintaining invariance to data heterogeneity.

papers.title: Derandomized Online-to-Non-convex Conversion for Stochastic Weakly Convex Optimization
papers.contribution: Provides a momentum-restarted SGDM variant with optimal theoretical guarantees and empirical effectiveness on ResNet and ViT networks.

papers.title: Distributed Direct Preference Optimization
papers.contribution: Derives convergence rates quantifying the impact of client drift, communication frequency, and preference heterogeneity for federated DPO, and establishes convergence over general communication graphs for decentralized DPO.

papers.title: Enhancing Communication Compression via Discrepancy-aware Calibration for Federated Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves 18.9% relative accuracy improvement at 0.1 compression ratio under severe communication constraints.

papers.title: Error Feedback for Muon and Friends
papers.contribution: EF21-Muon achieves up to 7x communication savings with no accuracy loss compared to uncompressed Muon/Scion/Gluon across NanoGPT benchmarks.

papers.title: Evolution Strategies at the Hyperscale
papers.contribution: Achieves 91% of pure batch inference throughput, enables stable pretraining of nonlinear recurrent LMs, competitive with GRPO on reasoning tasks, and maintains RL performance in tabula rasa settings.

papers.title: Fast Convergence of Natural Gradient Descent for Over-parameterized Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.contribution: Provides convergence analysis of natural gradient descent for two-layer PINNs, showing independence from Gram matrix conditioning and achieving improved convergence rates.

papers.title: Fast Frank–Wolfe Algorithms with Adaptive Bregman Step-Size for Weakly Convex Functions
papers.contribution: Our method achieves faster global convergence up to linear rate for convex optimization under Hölder error bounds and local linear convergence for nonconvex optimization under local quadratic growth, outperforming existing methods.

papers.title: FedMuon: Federated Learning with Bias-corrected LMO-based Optimization
papers.contribution: FedMuon can converge faster with more accurate LMO solutions and outperforms state-of-the-art federated learning methods in experiments.

papers.title: FedPDG: Prediction Discrepancy–Guided Data Generation for Heterogeneous Federated Learning
papers.contribution: FedPDG outperforms state-of-the-art methods, achieving up to 3.82% accuracy improvement.

papers.title: FedQueue: Queue-Aware Federated Learning for Cross-Facility HPC Training
papers.contribution: Controlled queue simulations demonstrate robust improvement over the baselines; in particular, up to 60\% reduction in time to reach a target accuracy level under high queue variance and non-IID partitions

papers.title: FedReLa: Imbalanced Federated Learning via Re-Labeling
papers.contribution: Significantly improves minority class accuracy and overall accuracy on stepwise-imbalanced and long-tailed datasets, outperforming state-of-the-art without additional communication overhead.

papers.title: FedSSM: State Space Model-based Proactive Inference for Heterogeneous Multimodal Federated Learning
papers.contribution: FedSSM achieves 2.5-4.5% accuracy improvements over state-of-the-art while reducing communication rounds by over 30%.

papers.title: FedVeer: Self-Adaptive Skew Estimation for Robust Federated Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves up to 6.36% accuracy improvement and reduces noise-induced degradation by up to 6.01% on real-world datasets.

papers.title: Federated Bilevel Performative Prediction
papers.contribution: Establishes FBPS existence and uniqueness conditions with validated stability thresholds and improved meta-generalization over non-performative baselines.

papers.title: Federated Causal Inference on Multi-Site Observational Data via Propensity Score Aggregation
papers.contribution: Performs well under site-level heterogeneity in sample sizes and treatment mechanisms; exploits heterogeneity to improve overlap when some sites violate positivity.

papers.title: Forward-KL Convergence of Time-Inhomogeneous Langevin Diffusions
papers.contribution: Provides non-asymptotic bounds for continuous and discrete samplers covering practical annealing schemes like geometric tempering.

papers.title: From Lyapunov Analysis to Algorithm Design in two-sided PL Minimax Optimization
papers.contribution: TALDA achieves linear convergence under the two-sided PL condition with explicit dependence on cross-smoothness, recovering existing rates while improving performance on weakly coupled min-max problems.

papers.title: From Muon to Gluon: Bridging Theory and Practice of LMO-based Optimizers for LLMs
papers.contribution: Provides state-of-the-art convergence guarantees matching theoretical assumptions to practice; experiments confirm assumptions hold along optimization trajectory.

papers.title: From Optimization to Generalization under Heavy-Tailed Data: The Role of Gradient Clipping
papers.contribution: Provides finite-sum convergence guarantees for SGD with clipping under heavy-tailed data and derives generalization bounds showing tail behavior at population minimizer links optimization and generalization.

papers.title: General Analysis of LMO-based Optimizers: Beyond Bounded Variance
papers.contribution: Establishes unified nonconvex convergence theory recovering known bounded-variance results as a special case and derives explicit batch-size scaling laws predicting optimal momentum-batch trade-offs.

papers.title: GeoEvo: Identity-Aware Potential Game with Geometric Evolution for Personalized Multimodal Federated Learning
papers.contribution: Improves personalization and robustness across diverse modality-missing patterns with convergence toward first-order Nash equilibria.

papers.title: Gradient-Free Approaches is a Key to an Efficient Interaction with Markovian Stochasticity
papers.contribution: Zero-order oracle approach more efficient than first-order oracle when mixing time less than dimension; complementary lower bounds confirm optimality of results.

papers.title: High-Probability Bounds for the Last Iterate of Clipped SGD
papers.contribution: Proves high-probability convergence of order 1/K^((2α-2)/(3α)) on smooth objectives for the last iterate of clipped SGD.

papers.title: High-Probability Convergence Guarantees of Decentralized SGD
papers.contribution: Achieves order-optimal convergence rates for non-convex and strongly convex costs with linear speed-up in number of users under relaxed assumptions.

papers.title: Improved Analysis of the Accelerated Noisy Power Method with Applications to Decentralized PCA
papers.contribution: First decentralized PCA algorithm with provably accelerated convergence and similar communication costs to non-accelerated methods.

papers.title: Improved Convergence Analysis of Topology Dependence in Decentralized SGD
papers.contribution: The novel analysis more accurately describes the effect of topology on convergence rate than prior work in both homogeneous and heterogeneous cases.

papers.title: Improving the Robustness-Utility Trade-off in Decentralized Learning over Sparse Networks
papers.contribution: Achieves linear speedup with transient complexity O((1-λ)^-2) and Byzantine-affected complexity reduced from O(δ²(1-λ)^-6) to O(δ²(1-λ)^-4), demonstrated on benchmark datasets.

papers.title: Last-iterate Convergence of ADMM on Multi-affine Quadratic Equality Constrained Problem
papers.contribution: Establishes convergence guarantees for ADMM on non-convex multi-affine problems with applications in robotics and neural network training.

papers.title: Latent Guided Sampling for Combinatorial Optimization
papers.contribution: LGS achieves state-of-the-art performance on benchmark routing tasks among neural combinatorial optimization baselines with theoretical convergence guarantees.

papers.title: Learning Rate Annealing Improves Tuning Robustness in Stochastic Optimization
papers.contribution: Demonstrates convergence rate of O(ρ^(1/(2p+1))/√T) for annealed schedules versus O(ρ/√T) for fixed stepsize, achieving increased robustness to initial learning rate misspecification.

papers.title: Lightweight Federated Incremental Learning via Decoupled Replay
papers.contribution: Li-FIL outperforms state-of-the-art methods by up to 10.14% in accuracy with superior resource efficiency on both old and new tasks.

papers.title: Linear Bandits beyond Inner Product Spaces, the case of Bandit Optimal Transport
papers.contribution: Achieves same trajectorial regret bounds as OFUL up to approximation term; regret interpolates between Õ(√T) and O(T) depending on cost function regularity and recovers parametric rate in finite dimensions.

papers.title: Lions and Muons: Optimization via Stochastic Frank-Wolfe under Heavy-Tailed Noises
papers.contribution: Provides convergence guarantees in Frank-Wolfe gap and derives new Lion/Muon variants better accommodating gradient noise.

papers.title: Local Constrained Bayesian Optimization
papers.contribution: Achieves polynomial convergence rates on the KKT residual for high-dimensional problems (up to 100D) and consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.

papers.title: Minimax-Optimal Aggregation for Density Ratio Estimation
papers.contribution: Achieves minimax-optimal error convergence, surpassing cross-validation and model averaging baselines on standard benchmarks and large-scale domain adaptation tasks.

papers.title: Mirror Descent Under Generalized Smoothness
papers.contribution: Establishes sharp convergence rates for deterministic, stochastic, non-convex and composite optimization, matching state-of-the-art under classic smoothness.

papers.title: Mitigating Staleness in Asynchronous Pipeline Parallelism via Basis Rotation
papers.contribution: Theoretically demonstrates that basis rotation minimizes basis misalignment and empirically shows reduced iterations needed for LLM training up to 3B parameters.

papers.title: Mixtures Closest To A Given Measure: A Semidefinite Programming Approach
papers.contribution: Provides both the number of clusters and strong initialization for clustering algorithms, with asymptotic convergence guarantees.

papers.title: Multi-Objective Learning for Diffusion Models: A Statistical Theory under Semi-Supervised Learning
papers.contribution: Derive conditions where row-stochastic converges faster despite smaller spectral gap; yield topology-design guidelines.

papers.title: Natural Hypergradient Descent: Algorithm Design, Convergence Analysis, and Parallel Implementation
papers.contribution: Matches state-of-the-art optimize-then-approximate sample complexity with significantly reduced computational overhead; demonstrates scalability on representative bilevel tasks.

papers.title: Near-Optimal Convergence of Accelerated Gradient Methods under Generalized and $(L_0,L_1)$-Smoothness
papers.contribution: For (L0, L1)-smoothness, provides provably optimal O(sqrt(L0) R / sqrt(eps)) bound in small-eps regime, removing all non-constant multiplicative factors from prior algorithms.

papers.title: Nesterov Finds GRAAL: Optimal and Adaptive Gradient Method for Convex Optimization
papers.contribution: Achieves near-optimal iteration complexity O(sqrt(L||x0-x*||^2/epsilon)) for L-smooth functions and generalized (L0,L1)-smoothness with adaptive stepsize.

papers.title: NorMuon: Making Muon more efficient and scalable
papers.contribution: Consistently outperforms both AdamW and Muon, achieving 21.74% reduction in training steps relative to AdamW and 11.31 percentage-point larger efficiency gain than Muon on 1.1B pretraining.

papers.title: On The Surprising Effectiveness of a Single Global Merging in Decentralized Learning
papers.contribution: Showed theoretically that a fully connected final merge in decentralized SGD can match parallel SGD convergence rates, reinterpreting model discrepancies as beneficial rather than detrimental.

papers.title: On the $O(1/T)$ Convergence of Alternating Gradient Descent–Ascent in Bilinear Games
papers.contribution: First result showing alternation improves over simultaneous counterpart in constrained setting; PEP indicates AltGDA achieves O(1/T) vs O(1/√T) for simultaneous methods.

papers.title: On the Benefits of Weight Normalization for Overparameterized Matrix Sensing
papers.contribution: Shows polynomial improvement in iteration and sample complexity as overparameterization increases, providing the first characterization of weight normalization's convergence benefits.

papers.title: On the Convergence Direction of Gradient Descent
papers.contribution: Proves directional convergence behavior in gradient descent and relates oscillatory convergence to Edge of Stability dynamics, providing new theoretical clarity on optimization behavior.

papers.title: On the Convergence of Decentralized Stochastic Minimax Optimization Algorithm with Compressed Communication
papers.contribution: The algorithm demonstrates theoretical convergence guarantees showing how the compression operator influences convergence rate while reducing communication overhead.

papers.title: On the Interaction of Batch Noise, Adaptivity, and Compression, under $(L_0,L_1)$-Smoothness: An SDE Approach
papers.contribution: Shows that normalizing updates emerges as a natural condition for stability under heavy-tailed and affine-variance noise, while DSignSGD converges under heavy-tailed noise with standard learning rates.

papers.title: On the Role of Batch Size in Stochastic Conditional Gradient Methods
papers.contribution: Theory reveals regime-dependent batch size behavior and aligns with empirical practices; provides principled batch size and stepsize selection guidelines with adaptive strategies.

papers.title: OrderDP: A Theoretically Guaranteed Lossless Dynamic Data Pruning Framework
papers.contribution: OrderDP reduces training cost by over 40% while maintaining competitive accuracy and stable convergence with exact performance control, serving as a robust, easily adaptable tool for data-efficient learning.

papers.title: Persistent Backdoor Attacks in Class-Incremental Learning via Structural Invariant Anchoring
papers.contribution: Derive conditions where row-stochastic converges faster despite smaller spectral gap; yield topology-design guidelines.

papers.title: Projection-Free Algorithms for Minimax Problems
papers.contribution: The framework provides unified analysis for nonconvex-concave and nonconvex-strongly concave settings, significantly narrowing the performance gap between projection-free and projection-based methods.

papers.title: Provably Accelerated Imaging with Restarted Inertia and Score-based Image Priors
papers.contribution: RISP achieves faster stationary-point convergence than existing methods without requiring convex priors, with proven theoretical rates.

papers.title: Rethinking Neural Network Learning Rates: A Stackelberg Perspective
papers.contribution: Establishes finite-time convergence guarantees and identifies two mechanisms by which non-uniform learning rates outperform uniform ones: Stackelberg objective optimization structure and sharper local curvature.

papers.title: Riemannian Federated Learning via Averaging Gradient Streams
papers.contribution: Achieves global convergence and sublinear/linear convergence rates under decaying and fixed step sizes with performance validated on synthetic and real-world data.

papers.title: Ringleader ASGD: The First Asynchronous SGD with Optimal Time Complexity under Data Heterogeneity
papers.contribution: First asynchronous SGD achieving theoretical lower bounds in smooth nonconvex regime with optimal time complexity under data heterogeneity.

papers.title: Row-Stochastic Matrices Can Provably Outperform Doubly Stochastic Matrices in Decentralized Learning
papers.contribution: Derive conditions where row-stochastic converges faster despite smaller spectral gap; yield topology-design guidelines.

papers.title: SFedPO: Streaming Federated Learning with a Prediction Oracle under Temporal Shifts
papers.contribution: Theoretically establishes convergence bounds and empirically demonstrates adaptation to streaming scenarios with distribution shifts.

papers.title: SGD with Adaptive Preconditioning: Unified Analysis and Momentum Acceleration
papers.contribution: Recovers state-of-the-art results for popular methods while providing first theoretical justification that AdaGrad benefits simultaneously from diagonal preconditioning and momentum.

papers.title: Safeguarded Stochastic Polyak Step Sizes for Non-smooth Optimization: Robust Performance Without Small (Sub)Gradients
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive performance to adaptive baselines on convex and deep neural network problems with stable behavior and robust non-collapsed gradients.

papers.title: Scalable Random Wavelet Features: Efficient Non-Stationary Kernel Approximation with Convergence Guarantees
papers.contribution: Outperforms stationary random features on non-stationary datasets with convergence guarantees, offering compelling accuracy-efficiency tradeoff for real-world non-stationary problems.

papers.title: Second-Order Bilevel Optimization with Accelerated Convergence Rates
papers.contribution: FSBA and LFSBA demonstrate that second-order methods can achieve accelerated convergence rates compared to first-order methods in bilevel optimization, with application to nonconvex strongly-concave minimax optimization.

papers.title: Server-Proximal Aggregation for Federated Domain-Incremental Learning under Partial Participation: Task-Uniform Convergence and Backward Tra
papers.contribution: Bounds backward knowledge transfer with drift-controlled terms and achieves task-uniform convergence at O(sqrt(E/(NT))) while explicitly separating optimization variance from inter-task drift.

papers.title: Single-Loop Byzantine-Resilient Federated Bilevel Optimization
papers.contribution: Achieves optimal Byzantine resilience and optimal sample complexity with single-loop efficiency.

papers.title: Sobolev Gradient Ascent for Optimal Transport: Barycenter Optimization and Convergence Analysis
papers.contribution: SGA achieves the same convergence rate as classical subgradient descent for nonsmooth convex minimization, with superior empirical performance and algorithmic/theoretical simplifications.

papers.title: Stability Analysis of Sharpness-Aware Minimization
papers.contribution: Demonstrates that momentum and batch-size are important for mitigating instability and achieving high generalization across optimization problems and benchmarks.

papers.title: Stochastic Gradient Methods under Heavy-Tailed Noises in Weakly Convex Optimization
papers.contribution: Provides high-probability convergence bounds with polynomial-logarithmic dependence on failure probability and validates findings through experiments.

papers.title: Taming Score-Based Denoisers in ADMM: A Convergent Plug-and-Play Framework
papers.contribution: AC-DC denoiser achieves high-probability fixed-point convergence under weakly nonexpansive operator conditions; experiments show consistent improvements in solution quality on inverse problems.

papers.title: Taming Stochastic Gradient Descent: Almost Sure Convergence and Saddle-Point Avoidance under $(L_{0},L_{1})$-Smoothness
papers.contribution: Shows that generated trajectories avoid strict saddle points with probability 1, converging only to local minimizers under relaxed moment bound conditions.

papers.title: Thinned Mean Field Langevin Dynamics
papers.contribution: Reduces computational complexity from O(N²) to O(N^3/2) while preserving the same convergence guarantees up to logarithmic factors, demonstrated on neural network training, quantization, and post-Bayesian inference tasks.

papers.title: Towards Rule-Based Knowledge Sharing in Federated Learning
papers.contribution: Achieves better accuracy-communication trade-off across heterogeneous settings compared to proxy-model and prototype-based approaches while maintaining personalization.

papers.title: Towards Understanding Adam Convergence on Highly Degenerate Polynomials
papers.contribution: Proves Adam achieves local linear convergence on degenerate functions, significantly outperforming sub-linear convergence of Gradient Descent; characterizes hyperparameter phase diagram.

papers.title: Trustworthy Federated Label Distribution Learning under Annotation Quality Disparity
papers.contribution: Theoretical guarantee showing client-specific calibration outperforms uniform calibration; superior performance on four constructed Fed-LDL benchmarks.

papers.title: Understanding Dynamics of Adam in Zero-Sum Games: An ODE Approach
papers.contribution: Analysis reveals that first- and second-order momentum parameters have exactly opposite roles in zero-sum games compared to minimization, validated through GAN experiments.

papers.title: Understanding MARS: When Scaling Momentum Provably Helps
papers.contribution: Theory predicts when optimized gamma outperforms unscaled momentum-based variance reduction, validated on GPT-style LLM pretraining.

papers.title: Understanding the Mechanisms of Fast Hyperparameter Transfer
papers.contribution: Work elucidates key mechanisms behind fast transfer in synthetic and practical settings including LLM training, proposing that rapid convergence of a specific trajectory component enables transfer.

papers.title: Unified Analyses for Hierarchical Federated Learning: Topology Selection under Data Heterogeneity
papers.contribution: Reveals three fundamental topology selection principles: top-tier aggregation dominance, dependency on client grouping, and inter-group heterogeneity primacy, validated on CIFAR-10/CINIC-10/Fashion-MNIST/SST-2.

papers.title: Unlocking the Potential of Weighting Methods in Federated Learning Through Communication Compression
papers.contribution: Establishes convergence guarantees while addressing communication bottleneck in federated learning with heterogeneous data.

papers.title: Unsupervised Disentanglement Without Compromises : How Functional Orthogonality Enforces Identifiability
papers.contribution: Derive conditions where row-stochastic converges faster despite smaller spectral gap; yield topology-design guidelines.

papers.title: Why Do We Need Warm-up? A Theoretical Perspective
papers.contribution: The resulting one-parameter warm-up schedule yields provably faster convergence guarantees than fixed learning rate and matches tuned linear warm-up on language and vision models.

papers.title: Zeroth-Order Non-Log-Concave Sampling with Variance Reduction and Applications to Inverse Problems
papers.contribution: Establishes first non-asymptotic convergence guarantees for zeroth-order non-log-concave sampling and posterior sampling via score-based generative priors.
